findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "openapi_summary" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Read an OpenAPI 3 or Swagger 2 document (JSON or YAML, up to 2 MB) from a URL and summarise it for an agent: title, version, description, servers, auth schemes,…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.detail: Description of "http_security_headers" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
